description: Full public profile of one listed product by its slug: plain-text description, website, categories, tags, tech stack, AI builders, votes, public traffic, social links. Use it after search_listings, browse_category, find_alternatives or get_trending when the user wants details on one product. Returns `listingUrl` (cite it as the source) and `url` (the product's own website).

slug.description: The listing slug, as returned by the other tools.

name: get_listing
title: Get a listing profile
